title: Negros sugar farmers get P410M in cash aid

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — Some 39,847 sugarcane farmers in Negros Island have received P410.28 million in emergency cash transfers (ECT) from the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) to help offset losses caused by the red-striped soft scale insect (RSSI), Regional Director Arwin Razo said on Sunday. Razo said aid distribution would continue until the end of the year, pending the release of additional funds. Total assistance could exceed P1 billion, he added. RSSI damages sugarcane by sucking sap from stalks and leaves, while the honeydew it produces promotes black sooty mold that blocks sunlight and reduces photosynthesis. […]...
